text:
Kai: Heads-up — I saw a ~12% p99 latency regression on prefill for short contexts (<=64) after last night's kernel-autotune rollout. Repro on A100 and H100.
Ashley: Oh no. is this from the new sequence-window scoring change? link to the PR?
Kai: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321
Kai: Autotuner is now scoring kernels by "windowed_throughput" and prefers a tiled GEMM for 64->128 windows. That pick is great for long ctx but the prefill short-ctx path is getting routed incorrectly.
Mohit: Can you paste the perf numbers and a short trace? curious if KV cache misses spiked too.
Kai: Quick numbers (prod-ish load):
- before: p50=32ms p95=58ms p99=92ms
- after:  p50=34ms p95=64ms p99=104ms
Kai: Small-hosted cluster, batch size distribution skewed to 1-2, sequence lengths 16/32/64 mostly.
Jen: ^ those p99 deltas smell like decode/prefill misrouting — maybe the path selection isn't distinguishing prefill vs decode kernels.
perf-bot: [auto-profile] job=autotune-run-2026-03-16 node=a100-42 nvprof-summary attached
Kai: Attached nvprof snippet (trimmed):
```
[CUDA] tiled_gemm_kernel 42.3ms  (chosen)
fused_mha_smallseq   18.1ms  (alternative)
KV_cache_rewrite      2.3ms
```
Ashley: tiled_gemm is the mispick for short prefill. fused_mha_smallseq has lower single-request latency but worse for large sequences — autotune score weighted throughput.
Mohit: So the autotuner objective is too throughput-heavy. It doesn't consider tail latency or decode/prefill tag.
Jen: Also noticed the routing code uses `select_kernel_by_seqlen(seqlen)` but that function is invoked before prefill/decode flag is considered in the path. we should invert the condition.
Kai: Repro script below (local):
```
python -m perf.run --model=gptx-small --seqlen=64 --batch=1 --prefill=true --requests=1000
```
Mohit: Proposed fixes:
1) Add path-aware constraints: require kernel candidates to have `prefill_safe` tag for prefill paths.
2) Add latency percentile to autotune scoring: score = alpha*throughput - beta*p99
3) Short-circuit: if seqlen<=64 and batch<=2 prefer `fused_mha_smallseq` unless memory constraints.
Ashley: Temporary mitigation: roll back the autotune scoring change and gate rollout to non-hosted clusters until we validate.
Kai: I ran a quick AB test with scoring reverted — p99 back within 2% of baseline.
Jen: Will open a small PR to add prefill flag to the selector and modify scoring. assign to Mohit + Kai for review.
Mohit: I'll add a unit test that simulates mixed decode/prefill traffic and verifies kernel picks.
perf-bot: [action] create perf-check job: autotune-shortctx-regression
Ashley: Also add a telemetry metric: kernel_pick_reason and chosen_kernel labels so we can query picks by (prefill,seqlen,arch)
Kai: good call. that will help detect future regressions quickly.
Jen: Timeline? we should hotfix in next patch release and keep the gated rollback until then.
Mohit: I can push the hotfix branch today, run perf infra tomorrow on A100/H100. will post results.
Kai: Thanks team. leaving logs and perf traces in #eng-runtime/perf-artifacts
Ashley: :thumbsup:
